integrity: The finite certificate is replayable from the embedded standard-library verifier; the homotopy conclusion uses the verified matching, signed Morse boundary, a unit determinant minor, Hurewicz, and Whitehead theory.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the explicitly defined eight-vertex Wagner graph.
No claim is made for larger Möbius ladders, all cubic graphs, or generalized Morse complexes.
An unindexed graph-specific computation remains a residual literature risk.
title: The Morse complex of the Wagner graph \(M_8\) is a wedge of \(147\) six-spheres
